test_title: PYST 3: SSC Stenographer - Reasoning (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 1 )
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e864f89daf5a7b785695aba964d50f0f287113f393874d558c32a5c9478fd68.png]
solution:
1) Here, we see that, each image in moving one step but in anticlockwise direction. Also, the image which is bottom left goes in the middle and the middle image goes to bottom right.

2) From fig 1 to fig 2 we get: The image image [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c8cc9cd7310af4284c0268599342f761fa72410b8dcddfd80c5ea102a62590bb.png] is moved one step down in anticlockwise direction. Then, the image [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3625155aaefc3ad6f771cb86d6fe1c9002cc6eeb6add1f0bfbdd79efae42e387.png] has moved in middle and the middle image [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d47511a5152d688fc95adb2cec13d8d403794350874fe0e25b8fb8c45f2d2d3.png] moved in bottom right. And so the other image [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/82758f5e69ee2274b93c1c7e84a62da4bc9f5d63893545520efc5f46452521c7.png] has moved at top right and last image [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3aad6ed7290874d1f83548dfa2c8ecdef68b6d1f18d816e4d1b4d42ed552fb06.png] has moved top left. This is the way all the images are moving.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4d1db773fdb052a1bd8c181c9d2a37bd8a41271a62dcea66b016bbdebf8d542a.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is '__**option 3**__'.
